title: Shapeshifter card powers 2/3
problem: Works backwards: your creatures take *more* damage from classes they beat, nothing from classes that beat them.
notes: In-game test: Shapeshifter set powers 2 and 3: an enemy Shapeshifter set holder hit by a non-weak attack takes 10% / 20% less damage; with no weak-branch bonus. Fix: S: fix branch / sign 2026-10-26 build check: not a byte edit. Code applies powers 2/3 inside the WEAK branch (defender beats attacker, bc_EventDamage L3987-L3992: bonus -= bonus x 0.1/0.2, then amount -= bonus = more damage taken). The text wants less damage taken from attackers STRONG against your creature. Hook spec: (1) skip the weak-branch statements L3987-L3992 (jump); (2) in the strong branch, after 'amount += bonus' (L~3950, @0x140e6c30b) when target.slot > 0 and card power 2 (3) is unlocked, multiply amount by 0.9 (0.8) - a call-site C hook on that add, reading target/slot via the self value at [rsp+0x21ef8] like hook_su0002_count_race.

release_notes.intended: Your creatures take 10% / 20% less damage from attackers whose class is strong against them.
release_notes.actual: The game worked the wrong way round: your creatures took more damage from attackers of a class they are strong against.
release_notes.fix: Now the reduction applies against attackers that are strong against your creature.
